## OfferUtils.getPrice() function

Converts an offer tick into its WAD zero-coupon price.

Use for display or local quote checks when accepting any plain object matching `IOffer` or an `Offer` instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getPrice(offer: Pick<IOffer, "tick">): bigint;
```

**Returns:**

bigint

WAD price rounded to the protocol price quantum.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `offer.tick` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `offer.tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { OfferUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const price = OfferUtils.getPrice({ tick: 5_000n });
console.log(price);
```
